appSubtitle: Create a smart tag for your adventure companion. 🐾
nfcModeDesc: Adds NFC chip cavity to the model
nfcChipInfo: Ø25mm × 0.4mm cavity at center — compatible with 25mm NFC tags
titleSimplifiedQR: Simplify the QR by excluding notes and second phone
hintPoor: Too detailed. Increase diameter or use Simple QR.
welcomeDescLine1: This tool generates a printable 3D tag for your cat or dog's collar.
welcomeDescLine2: The front has a QR code linking to a page with the owner's name and contact.
welcomeDescLine3: The back has name and phone in raised lettering.
welcomeStep1: Enter your pet's name and your phone number
welcomeStep2: Click "Generate preview" to see the tag in 3D
welcomeStep3: Download the STL file for two-color 3D printing
aboutDesc: A project for our friends' safety. Data is stored in the QR: no registration, maximum privacy.
tutorialText:
To achieve a perfect two-color result with the STL file:

In your slicer (e.g. Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer), use the "Paint" tool, select "Height Range" mode and set the height to 0.6 mm, then move to the base of the QR code or set the height to 3.01 mm and paint the rest.
tutorialInfoNozzle: It is recommended to use a 0.2mm nozzle for maximum readability.
tutorialInfoNozzle04: If you want to print with a 0.4mm nozzle, increase the tag diameter to at least 40mm.
videoFallback: Your browser does not support the video tag.
nfcTutorialIntro: The model includes a Ø25mm × 0.4mm cavity at the center to house a 25mm NFC tag. The chip is sealed on both sides.
nfcStep1: Orient the model in the slicer with a flat face down (front or back, your choice).
nfcStep2: Set an automatic pause at 2.0 mm height (≈ 10 layers at 0.2mm, ≈ 7 layers at 0.3mm) — at this height the cavity walls are complete. In Bambu Studio: Print Settings → Pause at layer height.
nfcStep3: When the printer stops, place the NFC tag in the circular cavity at the center of the model.
nfcStep4: Resume printing — the tag will be sealed by PLA.
nfcStep5: After printing, use the "Write to NFC" button in the app to program the tag with the card URL.
nfcGuideTitle: 📡 How to write to the NFC tag
androidStep1: Open this page with Chrome on Android (version 89+).
androidStep3: Bring the NFC tag close to the back of your phone when prompted.
androidStep4: The card URL will be written automatically. ✅
iosGuideIntro: Safari does not support NFC writing from the browser. Use the free app NFC Tools:
iosStep1: Download NFC Tools from the App Store (free).
iosStep5: Tap "Write" and bring the NFC tag close to the iPhone.
footerFoundAnimalDesc: Scan the QR on the tag or use the contacts above to help them get home. ❤️
